next.reason: 1985: after REWRITE the identifier-1 area stays available, the record-name-1 area does not except via SAME RECORD AREA. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR10 says the same, 'provided that identifier-1 is not one or part of one of the record descriptions subordinate to the file-description', citing §2023:14.9.35.4 GR6 for SAME RECORD AREA. The proviso excludes no conforming 1985 program: 1985 SR-IX.4.6.3-1 already forbids identifier-1 and record-name-1 to 'refer to the same storage area', and every record description of the FD shares that record area.
